channel.title: Utilix
channel.description: Update feed for Utilix, an all-in-one menu bar utility for macOS.

item.title: Version 1.0.59
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.59

- Screenshots now save to a real folder, starting with your Screenshots folder
- Opening the annotate editor or Settings no longer pulls you out of a fullscreen app
- The shortcut recorder now captures the keys you press, even when the menu does not
- The shortcut recorder ring now stays inside its pill

item.title: Version 1.0.58
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.58

- Multi-Snap shows up on the screen you are working on again
- Overlays stay at the right level again
- The annotate editor now fits the window it opens in

item.title: Version 1.0.57
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.57

- Scrolling in Utilix works normally again instead of fighting your input
- Utilix no longer grabs your whole screen while you work

item.title: Version 1.0.56
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.56

- Drag-to-select tools now respond to your very first drag, no second try needed
- The magnifier that used to appear while you dragged a selection is gone

item.title: Version 1.0.55
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.55

- Scrolling capture now scrolls the page for you
- It says which app is doing the scrolling
- You do not have to scroll by hand during a capture

item.title: Version 1.0.54
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.54

- Pages now scroll for you, no dragging a scrollbar handle
- Multi-Snap now appears on the overlay
- Multi-Snap no longer opens an editor window

item.title: Version 1.0.53
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.53

- Taking a screenshot no longer pulls you out of a fullscreen app
- Utilix now lives only in the menu bar, with no Dock icon
- After a capture ends, the app you were using stays in front

item.title: Version 1.0.52
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.52

- This update is about keeping Utilix running smoothly.
- Small fixes are included from the previous version.
- You will not notice any change in how the app looks or works.

item.title: Version 1.0.51
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.51

- Check the artifact, not just the library, before shipping an update
- Preload the providers you actually rotate between, and make the load measurable
- Sweep a rebranded copy so the release smoke cannot touch real preferences

item.title: Version 1.0.50
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.50

- Emoji search no longer crashes the app
- Emoji search opens and shows results again

item.title: Version 1.0.49
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.49

- Clipboard images now hand over their text so you can paste it anywhere
- The emoji picker now covers all of Unicode and builds skin tone versions
- QR codes now offer correction levels, quiet zones, export sizes and SVG
- Pomodoro timers now run in cycles, with a long break at the end of each
- Settings stays responsive during a backup or restore, and both can be stopped
- Compressing a batch of files now has a stop control and one delivery folder

item.title: Version 1.0.48
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.48

- Utilix no longer collects anonymous usage counts.
- Settings opens where you clicked and closes when you click the icon again.
- Settings stays on top of your other windows while it is open.
- Mac Vision appears on the desktop you opened it from.
- Opening Mac Vision again hides it.
- Scrolling capture: drag the handle and release to keep the capture.

item.title: Version 1.0.47
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.47

- Takeover works in the last few cases that were broken
- Duplicating items works in the last few places that failed
- Zoom now goes up to 200 percent
- Settings that were hidden now open normally

item.title: Version 1.0.46
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.46

- The area picker now shows what it will capture before you click
- Long page captures scroll the page for you
- Every permission prompt now offers a way to fix it on the spot
- Annotator adds a select tool, undo history, and an easy way out
- Both screenshot settings screens now show the same choices

item.title: Version 1.0.45
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.45

- Scroll capture now shows a panel with status, Stop, and Discard.
- Scroll capture guides you through each step and ends clearly.
- Scroll capture explains that the region stays fixed while the page moves.
- Window shots now save the window you pick, not a wide fixed shape.
- Two shots taken in the same second are both kept and saved.
- Save dialogs now stay above your other open windows.

item.title: Version 1.0.44
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.44

- Rows with no shortcut assigned no longer show Command-Space
- Only rows with a real shortcut show a key combination

item.title: Version 1.0.43
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.43

- Take screenshots of a window, the full screen, on a delay, or on repeat
- Assign your own global keyboard shortcut to any command
- Drag a window to the edge of your screen to snap it into place
- Palette search now matches every word you type, titles first
- Check for updates every 6 hours instead of every 12
- Fixed a crash that happened when dragging in the palette

item.title: Version 1.0.42
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.42

- Fix parallel guide race: build to /tmp, move into place at join
- Allow balanced 1-line Info.plist stamps on explicit re-runs

item.title: Version 1.0.41
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.41

- Taking a screenshot no longer crashes the app
- Screenshots now finish saving after you capture them
- Downloads from itch.io now show the version in the file name

item.title: Version 1.0.40
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.40

- Right-click files in Finder to copy a path, open Terminal, or create a new file
- Convert CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and YAML, check file hashes, get login codes
- Check your network: ports, traceroute, DNS, WHOIS and subnet details
- Zip files, merge and split PDFs, compress images, and remove photo data
- Take screenshots, mark them up, measure on screen, capture long scrolling pages
- Watch CPU, memory, disk and heat, and switch dark mode, hidden files or Focus

item.title: Version 1.0.39
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.39

- Settings sidebar is now grouped into clear sections
- Tab names now say what each tab actually does
- General settings moved into the tabs they belong with
- Nothing moved to a new place on its own

item.title: Version 1.0.38
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.38

- Utilix now sends one anonymous daily count so we can see how many people use it
- You can switch the anonymous daily count off in Settings at any time
- The daily count holds no personal information, just that the app was opened

item.title: Version 1.0.37
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.37

- Swiping to open Settings from a full screen app now works
- The Settings window now opens at a size that fits your screen

item.title: Version 1.0.36
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.36

- Teach the release-notes AI to write for humans + hard denylist
- Ignore Python bytecode caches (release scripts are .py)
- Print a short shipped-summary at the end of every release

item.title: Version 1.0.35
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.35

- Fixed a bug where swiping in Settings could slide a Space open by mistake
- The bring-here summon now appears correctly when you call it
- Swiping between Spaces in Settings behaves normally again
- New versions now reach itch.io right after each release, so downloads stay current

item.title: Version 1.0.34
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.34

- Menus now open correctly when another app is in fullscreen mode
- A step-by-step install guide PDF now comes with every release
- The install guide has new screenshots so setup is easier to follow

item.title: Version 1.0.33
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.33

- Screen recording permission now asks only once per launch.
- Permission prompts explain why they are needed before you choose.
- Denying a request no longer looks like you selected nothing.
- After you deny access, the app shows how to fix it in Settings.
- Better guidance for GIF, edge click, login, and hotkey setup.

item.title: Version 1.0.32
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.32

- Web chat is now turned on for you from the very first launch
- No extra steps needed to start chatting after a fresh install
- You can still turn web chat off at any time in the settings

item.title: Version 1.0.31
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.31

- Desktop Switch now starts off, and all global shortcuts are on by default
- Permissions tab now shows live status and a clear trust badge
- Screen OCR region capture is sharper with no blurry upscaling
- Canceling an OCR capture now clears the overlay right away
- More window snap positions now respond when you use their shortcuts

item.title: Version 1.0.30
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.30

- Desktop Switch now works on every screen, and clicks reach its panel
- The palette opens by itself each time you launch, if you turned it on
- Permissions are now requested only the first time you use a feature
- Calendar reminders no longer trigger a permission prompt
- Chat storage sizes are now calculated correctly
- On a fresh install everything is on except Calendar, and the menu fits

item.title: Version 1.0.29
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.29

- Downloads now arrive as a styled disk image with a clear layout
- Drag the app icon onto the Applications folder to install it
- The window opens already arranged, so nothing is hard to find
- This is now the standard download for every new version

item.title: Version 1.0.28
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.28

- See your country's public holidays in a rolling week strip
- Updates now install automatically by default for everyone
- Utilix can start at login and keeps asking until you say yes
- Settings now appears on the desktop Space you called it from
- Clipboard menu rows are simpler, with one clear line each
- Switching your default browser now shows an honest result

item.title: Version 1.0.27
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.27

- Clipboard history scrolling is now much smoother, even with lots of items
- Scrolling no longer stutters when hovering over saved clipboard items
- Copying a clipboard item while scrolling feels faster and more responsive
- Search results in your clipboard history now appear more quickly
- Clipboard history uses less memory when you keep many saved items

item.title: Version 1.0.26
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.26

- Send feedback faster with a new bug button in the footer
- Feedback reports now include your Mac model, memory, and last check time
- The About window now shows updates in one simple popover
- Check Again now confirms when you are already up to date
- The feedback keyboard shortcut now works from anywhere in the app

item.title: Version 1.0.25
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.25

- Send feedback to the developer without leaving Utilix.
- Open the new form from the About card or the command palette.
- Your report stays anonymous, with no personal details attached.
- Duplicate reports are merged so the same issue is not filed twice.
- A daily limit keeps feedback flowing and blocks spam.
- After sending, you can open the issue on GitHub yourself.

item.title: Version 1.0.24
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.24

- Downloads you start in web chat now save properly to your Mac
- A finished download card now appears with a Share button
- Save dialogs now suggest a name based on the page you came from
- Download buttons now behave the same everywhere in web chat
- Improved reliability when you have several downloads at once

item.title: Version 1.0.23
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.23

- Set your own keyboard shortcut to summon Utilix, right in Settings
- Menu bar items now jump straight to the tool you need, no dead ends
- Better VoiceOver labels, larger text, and roomier click targets
- Fresh look: cards adapt to your setup and tiles stay clean and flat
- Imports no longer risk wiping your data, and Stop acts right away
- Staying awake is capped at 24 hours and tidies up after a crash

item.title: Version 1.0.22
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.22

- Web chat: the plus button no longer flickers when you hover over it
- Web chat: signing in now happens right inside the chat panel
- Web chat: the panel now resizes to fit your zoom level
- Web chat: dialogs stay neatly inside the panel instead of spilling out
- Web chat: the sign-in window now matches your zoom setting

item.title: Version 1.0.21
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.21

- Error messages no longer appear on top of web pages that work fine
- Zoom now fits the WebChat window, and your sessions stay put
- Hovering over the chat window no longer makes it flicker
- Downloads save to your Downloads folder instead of opening as raw text
- You stay signed in when the app updates or when you quit
- Background cleanup keeps WebChat quick without interrupting you

item.title: Version 1.0.20
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.20

- Chat pages now check that content loaded before it appears
- Stopped chat loads no longer leave a loading placeholder behind
- Fewer blank or stuck chat screens when a page fails to respond

item.title: Version 1.0.19
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.19

- Updates now install and relaunch on their own, with no manual quit needed
- The app quietly takes over when a new version is ready to go
- No more prompts asking you to quit before an update starts
- You get back to work faster since the app restarts for you

item.title: Version 1.0.18
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.18

- Permission checks now run silently, with no setup wizard to click through
- Permission status shows as a simple list of rows in the app
- Fixed the About window buttons and the release notes shown there

item.title: Version 1.0.17
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.17

- Background update checks now tell you what happened every time.
- If an update fails, Utilix quietly tries again on its own.
- Retries are limited, so the app will not keep trying forever.
- Fixed a case where an update could be missed after 1.0.16.

item.title: Version 1.0.16
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.16

- Security checks in WebChat now stay inside the app window
- Fixed WebChat getting stuck on the Loading screen
- You can now add your own custom sites to WebChat
- Long site names in the WebChat list are no longer cut off
- Added a refresh button so you can reload WebChat pages

item.title: Version 1.0.15
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.15

- The chat window now has a slider across the top for quick adjustments.
- A new icon rail puts the main chat tools within easy reach.
- Chats open faster after the app has been idle, thanks to warm loading.
- You can now cancel a message with a single click on its icon.

item.title: Version 1.0.14
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.14

- New WebChat lets you chat with AI right from your menu bar
- Switch between chat services using new brand tiles
- Add your own access keys in the new WebChat Settings section
- Upload files in chat and get clear messages if something fails
- The chat window now opens and closes with a smooth fade
- Fixed a bug that could save your chat history twice

item.title: Version 1.0.13
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.13

- Color palette opens on its own once after you install or update
- Palette toggle now switches on and off more reliably
- New secure vault keeps your saved secrets encrypted on your Mac
- Your existing vault data moves over automatically, just one time
- You can now reset or export your vault data from inside the app
- Install updates with a single press, then see an Updated confirmation

item.title: Version 1.0.12
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.12

- Calendar shows a 7-day glance with day groups and countdowns
- Translate adds a formality picker and an editable glossary
- Emoji picker now remembers your recents and favorites
- Vision text cleanup toggles are now wired up
- Send-to drafts jump straight to the right pane
- Update errors offer Retry instead of saying you're up to date

item.title: Version 1.0.11
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.11

- Updates download quietly in the background and remind you later
- Install a downloaded update with one click from the menu bar
- Clipboard history has cleaner rows and pins no longer cover text
- The Settings window now opens in front of other apps, every time
- Saved passwords stay protected, with a one-time sign-in check

item.title: Version 1.0.10
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.10

- Check for Updates now starts the moment you choose it.
- No second click is needed to begin checking for updates.
- The update check begins right away from the status menu.

item.title: Version 1.0.09
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.09

- The status menu now opens neatly centered under the menu bar icon
- Software update checks now live in one place in the About window
- The About window shows the latest release notes for this version
- Small polish and internal cleanups for a smoother first release

item.title: Version 1.0.08
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.08

- You can now check for and install updates right from Settings, under About.
- Updates are more reliable thanks to a new built-in update system.
- Fixed a problem that could leave backup files in your Downloads folder.

item.title: Version 1.0.07
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.07

- Tapping a clipboard item now copies it instead of opening the full list
- On-screen messages now wrap at whole words so nothing gets cut off
- Pin buttons in clipboard history now show only when you hover over a row
- Pasting now only works in text areas where you can actually type

item.title: Version 1.0.06
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.06

- Utilix now saves a safety backup of your settings before each update
- Your saved passwords stay protected during updates
- If an update is interrupted, Utilix recovers on its own
- AI notes are now on by default and work automatically
- Updates are more reliable, with automatic rollback if something fails

item.title: Version 1.0.05
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.05

- What's New: auto-open palette banner once per version
- Release: opt-in AI polish (AgentRouter) for notes + banner stamp

item.title: Version 1.0.04
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.04

- Status menu: AppKit-centered popup + separators between every group

item.title: Version 1.0.03
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.03

- Release: sign with ed25519 account + key-match guard (fix 'improperly signed')

item.title: Version 1.0.02
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.02

- Right-click menu: replace custom panel with native NSMenu (flicker + no-dismiss fix)

item.title: Version 1.0.01
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.01

- Initial commit: Utilix macOS menu bar utility app
- Add Sparkle auto-updates, release tooling, and the isolated test app
- Performance overhaul + A-Z UI/UX pass and Keep Awake duration-switch fix
- Phase 1: ember accent standardization + rainbow cleanup
- Phase 2: type ramp floor 10pt + elevation shadow removal
- Phase 3: unify keycap renderer
- Phase 4: palette material pass
- Rewrite palette pager with SpacesRail two-finger-scroll method
- Fix snippet edit/delete, row click targets, nested-button double-fire + utility audit fixes
- Document agent workflow: architecture, research-first, production UI rules, build discipline
- Add repo-local opencode.json pointing at AGENTS.md
- Remove fixed snippet row actions from popover (hover pills in palette own edit/delete)
- Rebuild auto-type: stoppable engine, indent bypass, editable palette panel
- Auto-type refuses honestly without Accessibility instead of typing nothing
- Guard auto-type re-entry; spell out focus requirement in UI
- Make auto-type trust check and keycode map unit-testable; pin mapping/guard/refusal
- Seam auto-type event sink; prove firing order, wipe, unicode, cancel headlessly
- Auto-type newlines via Shift+Enter; expand tabs to spaces (script-faithful, never submits)
- Pin Sparkle floor to 2.9.6 (security fixes); sync docs
- Slider key/start delays with clamps; auto-restore typing focus; migrate old speed tiers
- Compact auto-type panel: header row, side-by-side sliders, short footnote
- Pin palette search bar; clip overflowing detail panes at the bottom
- Auto-type editor flexes into pane void; ember toggle
- Borderless Raycast-style search bar; loupe brightens on focus
- Drop palette close button; outside-click and Esc already dismiss
- Hover-only ghost icon row actions; drop solid text pills
- Phase 0 foundations: unify buttons/ghosts/icons/empties/motion, drop dead code
- Phase 1 palette: grouped sidebar, sectioned results, unified panes, ember AI
- Phase 2 popover: unified rows, merged placeholders, trimmed panes
- Phase 3 settings: unified rows, native About panel, cleanup feedback
- Phase 4 audit: full ember, pressed states, motion tokens, a11y labels
- Mac Vision captures everywhere via ScreenCaptureKit; clipboard append mode + text preview
- Mac Vision excludes own windows from capture; testable clipboard write path
- Mac Vision: testable OCR pipeline, blank-result guard, clipboard monitor baseline sync
- Stable self-signed identity ends the rebuild permission dance
- Shipped updates carry the stable identity; EdDSA public key matches keychain
- Stale-grant recovery script, stable DMG signing, free-forever release docs
- FDA onboarding auto-adds the list row; synchronous in-process trigger
- Never per-bundle reset FDA; add FDA probe support hook
- Fix quit-during-onboarding crash; nil-guard utilities cleanup
